propositions: plan-review PASS verdict should sign and persist an attestation by default across all public mutating entry points (CLI review-plan and library review_plan) unless explicitly opted out with --no-sign or sign=False
explicit unsigned execution requires deliberate opt-out at each public boundary: --no-sign for CLI, sign=False for library, with output clearly stating whether attestation was signed
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and local-source results must remain unsigned regardless of defaults, enforced at the attest.sign_plan_review boundary
re-running a plan review with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it idempotently without an LLM call or duplicate signature, preserving the signed_at timestamp
a PASS whose signature persistence fails must return the established retryable failure disposition and identify sign-review as the recovery path
CLI help text and documentation must accurately describe sign-on-PASS default behavior, explicit opt-out syntax, non-signable verdicts, and recovery mechanisms
